item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day has a lot of reminders in it, and very few of them are about food. That's the gap. Eating well doesn't happen by default when attention is elsewhere. Decide now what your next meal is, and make it something real, not whatever's closest. Eat it sitting down, without a screen, and notice when you're actually full. Action: pick your next meal right now and say it out loud.
